subtitle: Unsecured credit. Pay on time and raise your limit.
howItWorksBody: Request the credit you need and repay on time. Invite others: every time they repay, you earn a commission.
jobCycle2: Repay on time and build trust in your history.
jobCycle3: Level up and borrow a larger amount.
jobCycle4: Invite anyone who needs credit or wants to earn income.
jobCycle5: Earn for every loan your network requests and repays.
securityNote: One loan at a time. Paying on time levels you up.
payOnTimeToLevel: Make {count} on-time payments of your unlocked level to rank up
tokenNotEnabled: This token is not yet enabled. Only available for administrators.
referralLead: Share your code. Every loan repaid in your network earns you a commission. You get a .50 bonus on the first repayment.
youAreFounder: You are the founder — root of the whole network
bonusPaid: Already paid to whoever invited you
bonusPending: .50 bonus on completing your first loan.
royaltiesFrozen: Commissions suspended. Settle your debt to earn again.
referralHint: Paste the invite code here, or leave it empty.
shareMessage: {name} invites you to Quatrivium Credit. Get credit, repay on time, and earn by inviting others.
invalidSponsor: That invite code is not valid. Leave it empty if you do not have one.
creditActivated: Credit line activated. You can now request a loan.
loanIssued: Loan issued. Repay on time to level up.
feesWithdrawn: Token fees sent to the collector.
missingProjectIdBody: Wallet service not configured. Contact support.
configureContract: The contract is not configured. Contact support.
activateBeforeLoan: Activate your credit line before requesting a loan.
tokenNotEnabledAlert: This token is not yet enabled.
invalidAmount: The amount is not valid for this token.
connectForInvite: Connect your wallet to get your invite code.
interestRateCurveNote: Interest rate: {floor}%. May vary with demand.
poolLockedNote: Pool funds are not withdrawn: they stay to make loans.
moraBlocked: Account in default. Pay the outstanding debt to continue.
shareDisabledMora: You cannot invite while you have an overdue payment.
inviteLinkHint: Share the link via WhatsApp or any channel.
referralHistoryLead: Commissions received from your referral network.
referralNone: No one has registered with your code yet.
referralLoadError: The history could not be loaded. Please try again.
notificationLead: The app sends two payment notices per installment: at the midpoint and before the cutoff. Those notices are always on. WhatsApp, Telegram, commissions and new sign-ups are optional.
notificationSaveError: The alert channels could not be saved.
notificationDebtAlways: At mid-term and before the cutoff. No daily reminders.
notificationInvalidPhone: Enter a number with country code, for example +58412…
notificationTelegramHint: Telegram notification service is not configured.
debtReminderMid: You are at the midpoint of this installment. You can pay now instead of waiting for the cutoff.
debtReminderCutoff: Payment is due soon. Settle before the cutoff to avoid going overdue.
rankFrameHint: Your profile frame reflects your current rank.
sectionAccountLead: This is your personal account. Credit and the stablecoins or BNB you receive are yours. The liquidity pool is a separate box: it lives in the contract and is not mixed with this balance.
sectionCreditLineLead: Loans are requested and repaid only from this account. MetaMask and the others are for moving funds in or out.
sectionLoansLead: Every unlocked level stays available. Levels you have not reached appear in gray. Level 10 is the current maximum and still uses the cooldown between loans.
sectionInviteLead: Share your link. New people can borrow, and if they invite, they earn when their people borrow and repay. Overdue accounts cannot invite or earn.
sectionAlertsLead: Payment reminders via WhatsApp or Telegram.
txBusy: An operation is already in progress. Wait until it finishes.
appWalletFailed: This install could not open its wallet. Try again.
amountExceedsBalance: That amount is greater than your account balance.
poolNeedInternalFunds: First deposit the stable coin to your account, then contribute to the pool.
appWalletNotReady: This install’s wallet is not ready yet.
sectionPoolLead: The protocol’s collective box. This is not your personal account: if you contribute, the money enters the contract to fund loans and cannot be withdrawn to your wallet.
poolPublicLead: Deposited funds finance loans and generate yield.
adminLead: Authorized founder accounts only. Each change requires multiple signatures and confirmation.
protocolPaused: The protocol is paused. No new loans until it is reactivated.
confirmWithdrawFees: Send token commissions to the collector?
confirmWithdrawBnb: Send contract BNB to the treasury?
telegramNeedApi: The notification service is not available right now.
pauseProtocolConfirm: This stops loans and deposits immediately. Reactivating requires a proposal and 72 hours.
securityPausedBanner: Emergency pause active. Repayments still apply.
loanLockedBody: Complete on-time payments at your current level to unlock this amount.
maxLevelNote: Maximum level. The cooldown between loans still applies.
profileLead: Name and photo visible in your network.
profileNamePlaceholder: How your referrals will see you
profileNameInvalid: Use 3 to 20 characters: letter first, then letters, numbers or _.
profilePickPhoto: Choose a photo from the gallery
profileSaveError: The profile could not be saved.
profilePhotoDenied: Quatrivium Credit needs permission to use a gallery photo.
profilePhotoUnavailable: The gallery is not available in this build. Choose an avatar color instead.
referralEarnLevel: Commission if a referral requests and pays this level: {amount} (15% of the interest).
referralEarnLevel1: Gift for bringing them (first $1 payment): {bonus}. Commission if they borrow and repay this level again: {amount}.
referralEarnTitle: Your work: earn when they borrow and repay
referralEarnHint: You earn a commission every time someone in your network repays. No payment, no commission.
kycLead: KYC is required for credit. Your real name is already tied to this account. Country, city and document stay on this phone. The chain only stores a yes that you declared.
kycDeclare: I declare that this information identifies me.
kycDone: Declaration signed. You still need to link your number to request a loan.
kycNeedBeforeLoan: Complete the identity declaration before requesting a loan.
kycNotGov: Your information is private and protected.
kycToggleOff: KYC is optional in this trial phase.
referralHistoryPartial: This history covers recent blocks. Old commissions may not appear.
networkNotMainnet: Test mode active. Funds on this network have no real value.
lockSettingsLead: The password encrypts the wallet. An optional 6-digit PIN opens the app day to day. After 5 failed tries there is a wait. If you forget the password, restore it with the account email.
lockSetupLead: Create an optional 6-digit PIN for daily unlock. The password is what encrypts the wallet.
lockPinMismatch: The PINs do not match. Try again.
lockPinWeak: That PIN is too easy. Do not use repeats, sequences or obvious dates.
lockBiometric: Unlock with fingerprint or Face ID
lockBiometricUnavailable: No fingerprint or Face ID configured on this device.
lockPasswordLead: This password encrypts the key on the phone. You choose the length (at least 8). Do not use a 0x private key.
lockPasswordShowLead: Choose a password you will remember.
lockPasswordWeak: Use at least 8 characters, with variety. It cannot be a 0x private key.
lockPasswordPrivateKey: Do not use a 0x private key as the app password.
lockPasswordNoEmail: If you forget this password, you can restore it with the email of this account.
lockPasswordNotSeed: You type this key. It is not the 6-digit PIN and not the 12-word secret phrase.
lockPasswordTypeLead: Enter your password twice to confirm.
onboardLead: Gmail or Proton, a public username and your real name. The real name stays with your credentials and is never shown or written on-chain. KYC and phone come later, before credit.
emailLead: Gmail or Proton Mail only. Notices and the password-reset code go here. After you verify, this mailbox can restore your password.
emailNotAllowed: Use a Gmail or Proton Mail address.
emailDone: Email verified. Notices will go to this address.
emailTaken: That email is already linked to another account.
emailNeedApi: The email cannot be sent now. The worker needs RESEND_API_KEY and EMAIL_FROM.
emailDeliveryFailed: The email could not be sent. Check Resend on the worker.
emailCodeWrong: The email code is not correct.
emailExpired: The email code expired. Request a new one.
usernameLead: This is the name next to your profile photo. Other people see it. You can change it if the new one is free.
usernameHint: 3 to 20 characters: starts with a letter, then letters, numbers or underscore.
usernameLocalOnly: Name saved locally while no server is active.
fundsConfirmLead: Enable to confirm every money movement with your PIN.
fundsConfirmPrompt: Confirm with your PIN for this money movement.
deviceBoundTitle: This phone already has an account
deviceBoundBody: This device already has an active account.
otpLead: Required for loans. One number per account.
otpWorldNote: We will send a code by SMS or WhatsApp to confirm the number is yours.
otpOptionalNote: The number is required to borrow, just like KYC.
otpFounderExempt: The founder account also registers a phone and KYC.
otpNeedBeforeLoan: Link your number and this device before requesting a loan.
otpNeedApi: The code cannot be sent right now. Try again later.
otpDeliveryFailed: The code could not be sent. Check Twilio or WhatsApp Cloud API on the worker.
otpRequestFailed: Could not request the code. Reconnect the wallet and try again.
otpExpired: The code expired. Request a new one.
otpPhoneTaken: That number is already bound to another wallet.
otpDeviceTaken: This phone already has a bound wallet.
otpRate: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes.
otpToggleOn: Phone and device are required to borrow.
otpToggleOff: Phone binding is optional in this phase.
appWalletLead: This is your credit account. Deposit or withdraw with any compatible wallet.
appWalletPickLead: Choose the wallet you want to use to add or withdraw funds.
appWalletNeedGas: Deposit a small amount of BNB to cover network fees for your transactions.
appWalletInLead: Send USDT, USDC or BNB from your wallet to this address.
appWalletSendLead: Enter the destination address on the Quatrivium network.
appWalletDestroyLead: If you create a new account, the current one closes. Repay your loan and withdraw your funds first.
appWalletDestroyLoan: Repay the active loan before replacing this account.
appWalletDestroyConfirm: This account will be closed and a new one created. Unwithdrown funds go to the pool.
appWalletDestroy: Close account and generate a new one
appWalletDestroyed: Account closed. New account assigned. You must create a new username, email and KYC.
appWalletAdminConnect: Connect the admin wallet to continue.
appWalletOneAccountHint: Withdraw your funds and repay the loan before replacing this account.
appWalletReplaceHint: Withdraw your funds and repay the loan before replacing this account.
appWalletTopHint: Your account address. Use any wallet to deposit or withdraw.
securityLead: Identity and phone number are required for loans. PIN, fingerprint and backup are optional.
securityKycDone: Verification complete. You can now apply for credit.
securityPinHint: PIN is on. You can require it when opening the app.
securityPhoneTodo: Link your number. Required for loans.
phoneBannerDone: Number verified and linked to your account.
securityPhraseDone: Phrase noted. Keep it somewhere safe.
securityPhraseTodo: Optional. Required to recover access if you lose your device.
seedLead: Twelve recovery words. Write them on paper. Whoever has them can control the funds. This is optional; without them there is no way to recover this wallet if you lose the phone.
seedMissing: No backup phrase. Withdraw your funds before creating a new account if you want one.
seedConfirmSaved: I already wrote it down somewhere safe
seedRestore: Restore with a phrase you already wrote down
seedInvalid: That phrase is not valid. It must be 12 or 24 BIP39 words.
oneAccountLead: One account per installation. Repay your loan and withdraw your funds before replacing it.
lockOnOpenOn: PIN is requested when opening the app
lockOnOpenOff: Ask for PIN when opening the app
lockOnOpenNeedPin: Enable a PIN before requiring unlock on open.
lockCreateOptional: The PIN is required when opening the app. Change it here if you already have one.
kycOpenHint: Tap to complete your identity verification.
securityAccessKeyLead: Optional. Enable to open the app with your fingerprint.
securityAccessKeyTodo: Optional. Link your fingerprint as the access key.
securityAccessKeyDone: Fingerprint is linked as the access key.
securityAccessKeyFailed: The fingerprint could not be verified. Try again.
seedRotateLead: Creates a new phrase and closes the current account. Withdraw your funds first.
seedRotateConfirm: The current phrase will no longer be valid. Unwithdrown funds cannot be recovered.
seedRotated: Previous phrase deleted. Note your new phrase.
adminTimelockProposed: Proposal submitted. It can be executed after 72 hours.
adminTimelockConfirm: Opens a proposal executable in 72 hours.
executeAdminDone: The proposal was applied on the contract.
confirmAdminDone: Confirmation recorded. The timelock or more signatures may still be required.
adminAddFoundersLead: Paste a 0x address to propose changes. 2 out of 3 signatures required.
adminCofounderLead: You can propose adds, removals and who receives the 15%. Confirm or execute the current proposal after the timelock.
adminEnableTokenLead: USDT active from the start. USDC and FDUSD are enabled here with a 72h wait.
settingsAdminLead: Connect the founder wallet here to manage the protocol.
settingsAdminOk: Founding wallet recognized. Close settings: the Admin window appears on the home screen.
settingsAdminNot: This wallet does not have admin permissions.
payChoiceLead: You choose: pay the installment (based on amount and number of installments) or settle everything at once.
appModeLead: Demo uses fictional money. Live uses real USDT, USDC and BNB.
appModeSwitchDemo: Switching to test mode. Your account, ranks and real-mode loans are preserved.
appModeSwitchLive: Switching to live mode. Use real USDT, USDC and BNB.
appModeNeedDemo: Test mode is not available at this time.
appModeDemoBannerLead: Test mode. Ranks and commissions work, but USDT has no real value.
appModeStoreLocked: This store build runs only on live BSC. Demo mode is not available.
chooseLanguageLead: The whole app is shown in this language. You can change it later in Settings.
chooseLanguageHint: Tap your language. This screen updates at once. Then tap Done.
rtlNeedsRestart: Arabic and Urdu lay out the screen right to left. Close and reopen the app to apply the layout.
errKycRequired: Complete identity verification before requesting a loan.
errIdentityRequired: Verify your identity and link your number before requesting a loan.
errPhoneTaken: That number is already linked to another account.
errDeviceTaken: This device already has a linked wallet. Only one account per device is allowed.
errDeviceBound: This device already has an active account.
errAlreadyBound: This account already has a number and device linked.
errBadAttest: The verification code is invalid or expired. Request a new one.
errExpired: The authentication code expired. Request a new one.
errDailyCap: The daily limit for new loans has been reached.
errUtilizationCap: The pool is at maximum capacity. Wait for loans to be repaid.
errNoPriceFeed: This token has no reference price available.
errNoContracts: Calls from external contracts are not allowed.
errOnlyTimelock: This action requires a proposal and 72-hour wait.
errTimelock: The 72-hour waiting period has not yet expired.
errConfirmations: Other admins still need to confirm.
errSelector: That function cannot be run through governance.
errDelinquent: This wallet is marked delinquent. Repay before borrowing again.
errActiveLoanDestroy: Repay the active loan before closing this account.
errDead: This account was closed. Create a new account.
errFounderDestroy: The founder account cannot be destroyed.
errCooldown48h: You must wait 48 hours between loans.
errInsufficientLiquidity: The pool does not have enough liquidity for this level.
errPegLost: The token lost its reference value. No loans available right now.
errStalePrice: The reference price is outdated. Try again later.
errTokenMismatch: The token does not match your active loan.
errInsufficientAmount: The amount does not cover the full debt.
errExceedsLp: You cannot withdraw more than your pool position.
errLiquidityInUse: That liquidity is in active loans. Wait or withdraw less.
errInsufficientCash: The pool does not have enough funds for that withdrawal right now.
errInsufficientPool: There is not enough liquidity in the pool.
errSelfRegister: You can only register your own account.
errOnlyOwner: Only the contract owner can do this.
errOnlyAdmin: Only a contract admin can do this.
errNoTokenFees: There are no token fees to withdraw.
errNoNative: No network funds available to withdraw.
errPaused: The protocol is paused. Try again later.
errRpcMismatch: The network does not match Quatrivium Credit. Transaction will not be sent.
errRpcNoContract: The network does not recognize the contract. Try again.
errWrongNetwork: Switch the wallet to the Quatrivium Credit network.
errNeedGas: Insufficient BNB to cover the network fee. Deposit a small amount of BNB.
errInternalOnly: Loans can only be requested and repaid from this app.
errNoAdminProposal: There is no admin proposal to execute.
errNoWallet: No wallet connected. Use any compatible wallet.
errTokenNotInApp: This token is not enabled in the app.
createAccountLead: Set up your account to get started.
legalNameLead: Your real name is private. No one else will see it in the app or the network.
legalNamePrivate: Your real name is not visible to anyone else.
kycBoundNote: You can update your details at any time. Your account and level remain unchanged.
lockPasswordMin: At least 8 characters. You choose how long it is. Do not use a 0x private key.
lockRecoverLead: We send a code to the Gmail or Proton address of this account. With that code you choose a new password.
lockRecoverFail: Could not restore the password. Check the email and the code.
referralRepLead: Each referral adds points. Accumulate enough network points and the pool sends you a bonus.
referralRepNext: You need {left} more network points for the next {bonus} bonus.
liquidarLead: If a borrower has an overdue loan, you can liquidate it by paying their debt and receive a 5% reward.
liquidarAddressPlaceholder: Address of the debtor to liquidate
liquidarConfirm: You will pay this user debt and receive a 5% reward. This action cannot be undone.
liquidarDone: Debtor liquidated. Prize sent to your wallet.
marcarMorosoConfirm: This will mark the user as delinquent if their loan has expired. Continue?
